PR #367 is finished and I made no new commits this session. The previous session did get to the end: the resume fired at 07:52Z while the PR was still a draft on `dda0fba410` with no CI run, but after that it was marked ready.

Its state now:
- **Head:** `545c0ad20a`. The fold job merged master in; only the generated `nv2a_index.json` conflicted, and it was regenerated. The PR is mergeable, and the three CI checks on this head (two `build`, one `check`) all passed.
- **Labels:** `verified` and `fold-ready`, and it is not a draft.
- **Arm verdict:** PASS on `y16bump10-y16.json` (a `081dcf4a38` → b `50b46b0495`). `BumpMap_Y16` and `BumpMap_Y16_L` each went from 22,374 to 3,490 px. Of the 141 captures, 2 got better, none got worse and 139 were unchanged. `BumpEnvLum_Y16` did not move, which is what the prediction said. The 3,490 px left over is 1,914 above the floor and fits the vertical offset being the untested part; a later lane can test the high-byte reading for it with its own arm.

`NOTES.md` already explains why attempt 1 stopped (the PR had a merge conflict, so no CI could ever run on it) and records the verdict and the attempt-2 merge. I didn't push another note: a new commit would restart CI on a PR that is already fold-ready. My local worktree is fast-forwarded to `545c0ad20a`. Nothing is waiting on this lane; the fold job takes it from here.
